path = '/data/monthly_expense_ledger.xlsx'

df_raw = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name='Expense Ledger', header=None)
# find header row
header_idx = df_raw[df_raw[0] == 'Transaction ID'].index[0]
print('header_idx', header_idx)
# columns names from that row
cols = df_raw.iloc[header_idx].tolist()
print(cols)
# Now extract rows after header until end, but skip rows where first column is NaN or starts with month label or Total
# We'll create a dataframe from rows header_idx+1 onward
data_rows = df_raw.iloc[header_idx+1:].copy()
# Reset index
# Filter rows where column 0 (Transaction ID) is not null and starts with 'EXP-'
mask = data_rows[0].astype(str).str.startswith('EXP-')
filtered = data_rows[mask].copy()
# Assign column names
filtered.columns = cols
# Keep relevant columns
print(filtered.head())
print('rows count', len(filtered))
# Parse dates
filtered['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(filtered['Date'], errors='coerce')
# Filter
condition = (
    (filtered['Programme'] == 'Jal Jeevan Saathi') &
    (filtered['State'] == 'Maharashtra') &
    (filtered['Date'] >= '2025-04-01') &
    (filtered['Date'] <= '2025-09-30')
)
result = filtered[condition].copy()
print(result[['Transaction ID','Date','Programme','State','Amount (INR)']])
print('sum', result['Amount (INR)'].sum())
# Also check months present
print('months in data:', filtered['Date'].dt.to_period('M').unique())

import pandas as pd
path = '/data/monthly_expense_ledger.xlsx'
df_raw = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name='Expense Ledger', header=None)
header_idx = df_raw[df_raw[0] == 'Transaction ID'].index[0]
cols = df_raw.iloc[header_idx].tolist()
data_rows = df_raw.iloc[header_idx+1:].copy()
mask = data_rows[0].astype(str).str.startswith('EXP-')
filtered = data_rows[mask].copy()
filtered.columns = cols
# Clean column names strip
filtered.columns = [c.strip() if isinstance(c,str) else c for c in filtered.columns]
# Convert Amount to numeric
filtered['Amount (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(filtered['Amount (INR)'], errors='coerce')
filtered['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(filtered['Date'], errors='coerce')
filtered['Programme'] = filtered['Programme'].astype(str).str.strip()
filtered['State'] = filtered['State'].astype(str).str.strip()
# Check unique programmes
print('Unique programmes:', filtered['Programme'].unique())
print('Unique states:', filtered['State'].unique())
# Filter
cond = (
    (filtered['Programme'] == 'Jal Jeevan Saathi') &
    (filtered['State'] == 'Maharashtra') &
    (filtered['Date'] >= '2025-04-01') &
    (filtered['Date'] <= '2025-09-30')
)
result = filtered[cond]
print('Number of matching rows:', len(result))
print(result[['Transaction ID','Date','District','Amount (INR)']])
print('Sum:', result['Amount (INR)'].sum())
# Check max date
print('Max date in filtered:', filtered['Date'].max())
print('Min date in filtered:', filtered['Date'].min())
# Also check if any rows have Programme containing Jal Jeevan Saathi with extra spaces
print('Rows with Programme containing Jal Jeevan:', filtered[filtered['Programme'].str.contains('Jal Jeevan')])

header_idx = df_raw[df_raw[0] == 'Transaction ID'].index[0]
cols = df_raw.iloc[header_idx].tolist()

filtered.columns = [c.strip() if isinstance(c,str) else c for c in filtered.columns]
filtered['Amount (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(filtered['Amount (INR)'], errors='coerce')
filtered['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(filtered['Date'], errors='coerce')
filtered['Programme'] = filtered['Programme'].astype(str).str.strip()
filtered['State'] = filtered['State'].astype(str).str.strip()
# Show all Jal Jeevan Saathi Maharashtra rows
sub = filtered[(filtered['Programme']=='Jal Jeevan Saathi') & (filtered['State']=='Maharashtra')].copy()
sub = sub.sort_values('Date')
print(sub[['Transaction ID','Date','District','Amount (INR)']])
print('Total rows:', len(sub))
# Group by month
print(sub.groupby(sub['Date'].dt.to_period('M'))['Amount (INR)'].sum())
